column1: # Descriptive ADR citation labels, and the reason each one is allowed.
# A citation `ADR-nnn (label)` is normally checked by `engine/.pi/scripts/validate-adr-references.sh`:
# the label has to name something in that ADR's subject (its title, its `## Title` section, or its
# filename). Sometimes the label names the *interaction* instead — what this record does with that
# one — and that is a judgement, not a fact the guard can derive. A judgement with no record is the
# silence the guard removes, so it is recorded here with the sentence that makes it true.
# Adding a row is a review decision: the reason must say why the label is right for that document,
# and the guard fails a row with an empty reason. A label that is simply wrong belongs in the ADR,
# Columns (tab-separated): ADR-nnn <tab> label (lowercased, whitespace collapsed) <tab> reason
